Extremely consistent Belmont performer (13: 1-5-2) mapped to land the ideal box-seat run from barrier 1. Ran a close 4th over this track and distance two starts back on rain-affected ground. Major winning candidate.

In-form gelding coming off back-to-back placings at Bunbury and Belmont. Steps up to 1400m where he previously placed in 3yo maiden company. Claims weight via Zephen Johnston-Porter and should be prominent late.

Speedy Rommel gelding who missed by a nose over 1200m at Belmont two back after leading. Must stretch his speed out to 1400m from barrier 10, but possesses early tactical foot to cross and set the tempo.

Winner two starts back at Pinjarra Cl3 level (SR 74). Forgive last start from a terrible wide post. Drawn wide again here (barrier 13), but has the finishing turn of foot to pass beaten horses into exotics.
